sections.Profile:
A throwback to 80s and 90s pinball machines, built by Chicago Gaming Company with Play Mechanix and based on Quentin Tarantino's 1994 cult classic film, with 13-segment alphanumeric score displays and a single-level playfield with no ramps. Designed by Mark Ritchie in his first game in decades, with sound and music by David Thiel.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Gaming Company
- Years made: 2023
- In production: yes
